exclude_useless_assignment_diagnostic_on.limitation: Overlapped six Ruby validation workers; exclusion is not an enforcement change.

correctness_scope: Performance-only invariance against frozen 169-offense baseline, not a claim of Ruby parity. Baseline contains known Rust-only false positives, repaired separately on the integration branch. Full Ruby/native result reconciliation is a separate required gate.
changes: Compute unused-variable typo suggestions lazily, only for an offense needing them.
Index scope anchors by source position instead of rescanning all nodes for every scope.
Cache Rack::Test::Methods inclusion once per source.
Defer NonNilCheck ancestor analysis until an expression matches.
Reject irrelevant RSpec method names before ancestor/scope analysis.
profiling: Temporary diagnostic-only instrumentation timed source/model cops and AST callbacks; instrumentation is not committed or included in measured optimized binary.
measurement_limits: Single cold measurement per variant; baseline ran with some parallel validation workload.
Optimized final cache-population and warm measurements were run after other agents paused expensive jobs.
Current correctness-integrated output and later dispatch optimization require separate validation and timing.
